meta.note: Curated file, maintained by hand. The office a county's ballot prints, mapped to a published office description. Not generated: an office and the words a board prints for it change at most yearly, while which counties print which titles changes every election. The population this is measured against is generated --- data/vtrapp-contest-survey.json --- and npm run check fails when a surveyed title matches nothing here.

corrections.note: Misspelling in the county's own ballot data. Listed whole rather than as a rule, so the exception stays auditable and so fixing it upstream shows up here as a dead correction.

corrections.printed: FOR MAYOR OF THE CITY OF URBANA
corrections.read_as: For Mayor of the City of Urbana
corrections.note: Champaign prints this one title in capitals. Listed whole rather than case-folded: case-folding every title would also accept a title whose capitalisation is the only thing distinguishing it, and this is the only capitalised title in all seventy counties.

corrections.printed: For Judge of the Court of Appeals (4th Distrit)
corrections.read_as: For Judge of the Court of Appeals (4th District)
corrections.note: Misspelling of "District" in the county's own ballot data.
